document:616.text:
Your Ladyship,
Lord Progenitor has been made aware of your proposal and looks upon it with great displeasure.
Should you insist on proceeding with your plan, <style="highlight">gently stroke the surface of the mirror with your hand</style> to speak with Lord Progenitor directly.
Alternatively, you may write a letter and entrust it to me.
<align="right">Your loyal servant
document:616.source_cn:
领主阁下：
始祖殿下已听闻您的计划。他对此非常不赞同，特派我转达。
若您坚持，可以<style="highlight">以手缓慢抚镜</style>，通过镜面与始祖殿下沟通。
或者您也可以选择留信，我会替您转达。
<align="right">忠诚的仆人

say:0:1831507001:0.text: Tsk, another mirror here... I think I'll just look around for clues nearby.
say:0:1831507001:0.source_cn: 怎么这里还有镜子啊……算了，就在附近找找线索吧。
say:0:1831507001:0.male: Tsk, another mirror here... I think I'll just look around for clues nearby.
say:0:1831507001:0.female: Tsk, another mirror here... I think I'll just look around for clues nearby.

say:0:1831508001:0.text: Slowly tracing a hand over the mirror... Sounds like the trigger for some kind of spell to me.
say:0:1831508001:0.source_cn: 缓慢抚摸镜子……感觉像是某种魔法术式的启动手势。
say:0:1831508001:0.male: Slowly tracing a hand over the mirror... Sounds like the trigger for some kind of spell to me.
say:0:1831508001:0.female: Slowly tracing a hand over the mirror... Sounds like the trigger for some kind of spell to me.

say:0:1831509001:0.text: Could that chest over there contain the Soul Inhibitor?
say:0:1831509001:0.source_cn: 前面有个宝箱，会不会就藏着所谓的灵魂阻断剂？
